response.query: What search-validation approaches and seed-study strategies maximize sensitivity and precision for IoT-in-healthcare literature across major databases?
response.answer: Search-validation approaches include using Boolean operators and keywords like "IoT healthcare" for precision. Seed studies focus on seminal papers and systematic reviews. Combining these maximizes sensitivity and precision.

results.title: India's Most Recognizable Indian Brands
results.content: # India’s Most Recognizable Indian Brands. GoAir is a low- cost Indian airline that is part of the Wadia Group. GoAir Flights are known for its efficiency and is the fifth largest airline in India. With both business-class and economy flights, GoAir has been able to compete with the best in the business and carve a niche for itself in the aviation sector. With affordable fares and great services, GoAir has been able to compete with well-established airlines and make a name for itself in the aviation sector. The brainchild of Rakesh Gangwal and Rahul Bhatia, Since its inception in August 2006, IndiGo has grown from a carrier with one plane to a fleet of 155 aircraft today. The parent company of the IndiGo Airlines, InterGlobe Enterprises, has it’s headquarter in Gurgaon, Haryana with IGI airport in Delhi as its operational hub. Indigo was awarded the Skytrax World Airline Award for being the best low-cost airline of India and the Central Asia at the World Airline Awards, Farnborough, UK in July 2012.
